description: Add money to the prepaid balance of the configured GLIANA_API_KEY (the balance shown at https://dashboard.glianalabs.com). With a wallet key configured (GLIANA_WALLET_KEY / GLIANA_SOLANA_KEY) this PAYS `usd` from that wallet now and the balance is credited at once — it spends real money, so only call it when the user asked to top up. Without a wallet it returns an exact USDC amount and address for the user to send from any wallet or exchange (credited within about 15 minutes; check with get_balance). usd: whole dollars, 1-100 (5, 10, 25, 50 or 100 for a manual transfer).

network.description: For a manual transfer: which chain to send USDC on (default base).

usd.description: Dollars to add to the balance.

name: top_up
